en-US.author: TAPATCH
en-US.description: Installs, updates and opens every TAPATCH tool in one click, with update alerts from the tray. Installers only run if TAPATCH's signature vouches for them.
en-US.license: Free for personal use; commercial use requires a paid license
en-US.longDescription:
TA Hub lists every TAPATCH tool with its screenshots, videos, release notes and download count, the same as its page on tapatch.com. Install any tool in one click, update everything at once, open, reinstall or uninstall them, or go back to an older version. New tools show up by themselves, and TA Hub can wait in the tray and tell you when a tool you have gets an update. Every installer comes straight from tapatch.com and only runs if TAPATCH's signature vouches for it.

Free for personal use; business or commercial use requires a paid license.
en-US.name: TA Hub
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Now opens in virtual machines, Remote Desktop and on PCs without a graphics driver: it switches to Direct3D 12 when OpenGL doesn't work
- If the window still can't open, a message says why instead of the app closing without a word
